ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: In the image, there are two blue slanted lines with the same magenta arrow markings, indicating that they are parallel to each other; another blue slanted line passes through these two parallel lines from the upper left to the lower right, and is a transversal. The upper intersection is marked with the angle (x−8)°, and the lower intersection is marked with the angle 120°. According to the corresponding angle relationship formed when parallel lines in the figure are cut by a transversal, these two angles are equal. Therefore x−8 = 120. Solving gives x = 120 + 8 = 128.
